mapper.select: select a.*, b.ID as epId,b.SN as epSn,b.MODEL_ID as epModelId,b.PROCESS_INSTANCE_ID as epProcessInstanceId, b.EMP_TASK_SELF_SCORE as epEmpTaskSelfScore,b.EMP_EXPRESSION_SELF_SCORE as epEmpExpressionSelfScore, b.EMP_TASK_SCORE as epEmpTaskScore,b.EMP_EXPRESSION_SCORE as epEmpExpressionScore, b.EMP_SEASON_SCORE as epEmpSeasonScore,b.EMP_SEASON_LEVEL as epEmpSeasonLevel,b.STATUS as epStatus from BIZ_EMP_TASK_FLW a left join BIZ_EMP_PERFORMANCE b on a.USER_ID = b.USER_ID and a.ORG_ID = b.ORG_ID and a.YEAR = b.YEAR and a.SEASON = b.SEASON and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and b.STATUS in ('0','1') ${ew.customSqlSegment}

select emp.USER_ID as userId,emp.USER_NAME as userName,emp.ORG_ID as orgId,emp.ORG_NAME as orgName, emp.YEAR as year,emp.SEASON as season,emp.FIRST_ORG_ID as firstOrgId,emp.FIRST_ORG_NAME as firstOrgName, a.ID as id,a.SN as sn,a.MODEL_ID as modelId,a.PROCESS_INSTANCE_ID as processInstanceId,a.STATUS as status, b.ID as epId,b.SN as epSn,b.MODEL_ID as epModelId,b.PROCESS_INSTANCE_ID as epProcessInstanceId, b.EMP_TASK_SELF_SCORE as epEmpTaskSelfScore,b.EMP_EXPRESSION_SELF_SCORE as epEmpExpressionSelfScore, b.EMP_TASK_SCORE as epEmpTaskScore,b.EMP_EXPRESSION_SCORE as epEmpExpressionScore, b.EMP_SEASON_SCORE as epEmpSeasonScore,b.EMP_SEASON_LEVEL as epEmpSeasonLevel,b.STATUS as epStatus from BIZ_EMP_ASS_LIST emp left join BIZ_EMP_TASK_FLW a on emp.USER_ID = a.USER_ID and emp.ORG_ID = a.ORG_ID and emp.YEAR = a.YEAR and emp.SEASON = a.SEASON and a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and a.STATUS in ('0','1') left join BIZ_EMP_PERFORMANCE b on a.USER_ID = b.USER_ID and a.ORG_ID = b.ORG_ID and a.YEAR = b.YEAR and a.SEASON = b.SEASON and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and b.STATUS in ('0','1') ${ew.customSqlSegment}
